defectsFoundByScreenshots.symptom: Summary tiles collapsed into narrow vertical columns in desktop hero side rails
defectsFoundByScreenshots.repair: Hero SummaryTiles now use 2 columns at lg/xl and SummaryTile text has min-width/wrapping hardening

defectsFoundByScreenshots.symptom: Long prefix/suffix adornments clipped on mobile
defectsFoundByScreenshots.repair: Mobile stacked adornments are full width with whitespace-normal and break-words; truncation utility removed

defectsFoundByScreenshots.symptom: Workbench tree labels ellipsized important navigation labels
defectsFoundByScreenshots.repair: Tree labels now wrap with break-words and row alignment adjusted for multi-line labels

defectsFoundByScreenshots.symptom: Detail pane collapsed in constrained desktop card because split was based on viewport rather than component width
defectsFoundByScreenshots.repair: ListDetailShell now uses a container-query-owned grid and stacks panes until its own width can support the split

defectsFoundByScreenshots.symptom: Long tab text could clip under scroll/wrap modes
defectsFoundByScreenshots.repair: Scrollable tabs can grow to label width; wrapping tabs use break-words

defectReopenDecision: All SB11-discovered visual defects were repaired in shared standard components/Tailwind sources before closure; no owning subbundle remains reopened.
